description:
Not all pink glass is created equal! 🩷 In this reel, our antique & collectibles specialist Jacqueline walks us through a tell-tale sign of authentic Depression glass.

Why does it matter? Spotting genuine pieces helps you understand their history, care for them properly, and know when you’ve found a real treasure hiding on a shelf.

Have any other questions about vintage and antiques? Drop them below 👇🏼 and we’ll test Jacqueline’s knowledge in a future reel!
